say: Agle mangalvaar ko paune teen hazaar rupaye de dunga.

Abhi dhai hazaar bhej raha hoon, baaki shukravaar ko.
Dedh lakh rupaye ikkees tareekh tak pakka.
Saadhe saat sau rupaye COD hai, cash ready rakhna.
Total pachpan sau banta hai, somvaar ko transfer karunga.
Unnees hazaar paanch sau ka EMI hai, teen tareekh ko katega.
Untalis hazaar rupaye budhvaar ko de dunga.
Unsath hazaar ka cheque guruvaar ko milega.
I will pay fifteen thousand on the fifteenth.

Sattar hazaar ka balance hai, sattaees tareekh ko clear.
Saadhe barah hazaar ka bill hai sir.
Paune do sau rupaye delivery charge lagega.
Sava teen sau ka recharge kar dena, ravivaar se pehle.
Ek lakh bees hazaar unattees tareekh ko dunga.

Mera number note karo: nine eight double four, seven one two, triple zero.
Is number pe call karna: saat zero nau do, teen teen, chaar ek paanch chhe.
Callback number hai double nine eight six, zero five one, do do saat.
Aath teen ek ek, nau zero, saat chhe paanch chaar pe phone karo, saadhe chaar hazaar ke baare mein.
My number is six three double zero, one nine eight, four seven two.
Nau chaar triple one, aath do, saat teen zero pe shukravaar ko call karna.
